answer: Queue position is not first-come: submissions are ranked by how many entries their funding cluster has waiting. The k-th entry from one cluster waits k epochs, so a farm filing a thousand aliases sends its last puppet to the back of a thousand-epoch voyage, while an honest cluster holding one entry clears next round. Membership is read from shared custody and transfer roots, so new wallets merge the branches; the mirror shows one face. Waiting identities still pay bonds and must stay live, so capital piles up like a dune. The thousandth clone waits 250 days for nothing.
